Marks a noindex page and still follows its links when robots directives are respected

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"max_depth\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":true}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.crawl(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.pages().count)
debugPrint(result.pages()[0].noindexDetected())
debugPrint(result.pages()[0].nofollowDetected())
debugPrint(result.pages()[1].noindexDetected())
debugPrint(result.pages()[1].nofollowDetected())
```
